answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond of real value before it can transact, like a cedar post sunk deep to anchor a fence. A single identity that misbehaves loses its bond, and a gale of fresh fake identities each has to pay the full bond, so mass-producing sock puppets costs real money instead of a few keystrokes. Honest agents get the bond back after a clean record, and the thread of forfeited bonds funds verification, making sybil attacks expensive and self-defeating.
